items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: like Jabbo Smith or that type of trumpet player who could play their act

ctx.x: That Louis Armstrong made these -- this couple famous, cause he played every step they made. And he screamed the whole act, playing trumpet, and every movement that they made, Louis would make it on his horn, and that made Brown and McGraw one of the most famous dance acts in Chicago, at that time. And Brown and McGraw, when they would travel, they would look for some trumpet player to play because without a trumpet player their act didn't mean a thing. And so they had to have a good adlib jazz trumpet player to…
player who could play their act or else the act was lost.
